conbody.p: This vehicle contains software with open source licenses.
Open source software information including the source code, copyright notices and referred license terms may be obtained on the website https://worldwide.kia.com/en/opensource.

Kia Corporation will provide the open source code to you in storage medium such as CD-ROM for minimum charge covering the cost of performing source distribution upon email request to opensource@kia.com within a period of 3 years from the date of product purchase.
